data.name: Huzaifah
data.gender_notes: Huzaifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Huzaifah was a close companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). His name signifies strength, loyalty and deep faith. The name Huzaifah carries the meaning “The Prophet's Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huzaifah usually hope their child will grow to embody the prophet's companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who is strong in faith and unwavering in loyalty to Allah and His Messenger.
data.etymology: Huzaifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Prophet's Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huzaifah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Huzaifah
in_english.meaning: Huzaifah means protection, preservation, and safety in Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Huzaifah is a masculine Arabic name derived from the root 'ḥ-ẓ-f' which connotes the meanings of protection, preservation, and safety. Historically, the name is associated with Huzaifah ibn al-Yaman, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and a renowned narrator of Hadith. The name signifies spiritual safeguarding and divine protection.

data.cultural_impact: Huzaifah ibn al-Yaman was one of the Ten Promised Paradise, the closest companions of Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him). He was known for his extreme courage in the cause of Islam, and his unwavering loyalty to the Prophet, even in the face of adversity. Huzaifah's name has become synonymous with strength, bravery, and unflinching devotion to the faith. In Muslim societies, numerous mosques, schools, and community centers bear his name as a testament to his enduring legacy.
data.spiritual_significance: Huzaifah's name is deeply rooted in the spiritual life of Muslims. He was one of the few companions who were granted the unique privilege of being invited to the Prophet's home daily for lessons in the Quran and Hadith. Huzaifah's life exemplifies the true meaning of submission to Allah, as evidenced by his willingness to sacrifice his own life in defense of Islam and his unwavering commitment to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Huzaifah serves as a constant reminder for Muslims to strive for spiritual growth through mastering Islamic knowledge, and to emulate the courage and loyalty of this great companion in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Prophet's Companion" symbolizes Huzaifah was a close companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). His name signifies strength, loyalty and deep faith.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Huzaifah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the prophet's companion.
